caption_card:
BUREAU OF LEISURE NO. 0015
VENETIAN POOL. CORAL GABLES, MIAMI.
OPENED 1924 AS THE VENETIAN CASINO.
CUT FROM A FOUR-ACRE LIMESTONE QUARRY.
PHINEAS PAIST WITH DENMAN FINK. A GRAND WATERFALL.
820,000 GALLONS OF WELL WATER. LISTED IN 1981.
BRING SOMEONE WHO SUMMERED SOMEWHERE WITH A POOL.
IN A WORD: LEAFY.
alt_text: Venetian Pool, Coral Gables, Miami. A public swimming pool set in a former limestone quarry, with coral rock walls, palms, a waterfall and a bridge to an island.
